scope: EXPOSED independent simple synthetic sampler seam falsifier; not heldout

fixtures.coordinateConvention: source pixel centers at integer x,y; source samplers Math.round or bilinear as original APIs
fixtures.nominalStrip: infinite horizontal ribbon; yLower=centerY−width/2, yUpper=centerY+width/2; all x in raster
fixtures.crispEquation: coverage(y)=1 iff yLower <= integer y < yUpper, else0; half-open convention explicit
fixtures.AAEquation: coverage(y)=max(0,min(y+0.5,yUpper)−max(y−0.5,yLower)); pixel footprint width1 px; no multisample approximation
fixtures.quantization: RGBA=[floor(100+45*coverage+0.5)] repeated RGB, alpha255; no alpha muting

widthDefinitions.nonzeroRasterSpanPx: count rows with stored RGB>100; support span, not physical width
widthDefinitions.bilinearHalfLevelEdgeSeparationPx: distance of left/right crossings of122.5 in linear interpolation of stored row luminance; diagnostic, not source edge fit
widthDefinitions.fittedEdgeWidthPx: literal edgePairOf wPx from original smoothed-gradient source API

query.state: x80,y80+samplePhase,heading0; width varies over same bank
query.segment: tee[30,80+samplePhase] badge[130,80+samplePhase]; abstract construction anchors only
query.edgePairOptions: original defaults tolW3 latLim12 minOk source EVIDENCE

predictions: Crisp integer point raster may remain unchanged across some fractional ribbon shifts and jump at a seam; AA may vary smoothly in stored levels but quantization can preserve plateaus.
Dev72 nearest samples may change discontinuously as query phase crosses a rounding boundary; bilinear profiles may vary between integer rows. Neither sampling mode is presumed more accurate.
Numeric Dev72 selected width may be tied across raw width scores. Preserve exact winning rows and label strict-identifiability UNKNOWN when no strict finite best.
Source edge fit may be stable or vary under AA and subpixel shifts; no assumed AA improvement, calibration confidence or physical accuracy.
falsifiers: all same-source profiles/channels invariant across phases weakens phase-sensitivity prediction
AA equal-or-worse descriptive fit/score variation falsifies any blanket AA-stability-benefit hypothesis
all tied raw scores defeat unique learned-width interpretation regardless numeric legacy return
any failed or null fit stays native absent/UNKNOWN, never filled from nominal construction

sources.adaptation: none; exact independently fetched source; Node builtin type stripping

limits: <=16 deterministic construction fixtures only;64 explicit pose rows; no production detector or threshold added
Source bank/knobs are existing algorithm inputs, never accepted physical/calibration constants
Only synthetic grayscale flat background; no texture, rotation, occlusion, routes or endpoints
Construction math and width diagnostics are fixture descriptions, not new detector signal
No C2/C6 candidate reading; no old probe execution; no S7 defaults or AA muting
Same process repeat verifies deterministic outputs only, not cross-runtime reproducibility
